stories.headline: Middle East Peace Talks Collapse Amid Border Dispute Escalation
stories.summary: Diplomatic efforts failed to resolve key border issues, raising fears of renewed regional instability and impacting global oil markets.

stories.headline: Global AI Consortium Unveils Landmark Ethical Guidelines for Development
stories.summary: Leading tech firms and governments agreed on crucial AI ethics standards, aiming to ensure responsible innovation and prevent misuse globally.

stories.headline: European Central Bank Holds Rates Steady Amid Stagnant Growth Concerns
stories.summary: The ECB kept interest rates unchanged, signaling caution over persistent inflation and weak economic recovery across the Eurozone.

stories.headline: New Gene Therapy Shows Promise in Treating Rare Neurological Disorder
stories.summary: Clinical trials reveal a novel gene therapy significantly slows progression of a debilitating neurological condition, offering hope to thousands.

stories.headline: Southern African Nations Grapple with Severe Drought and Food Shortages
stories.summary: Millions face acute food insecurity as prolonged drought devastates crops across several Southern African countries, prompting urgent aid appeals.
